Lareaux's Furniture Paste Wax is a wood cleaner, conditioner and protectant that adds a beautiful luster and shine to any furniture. It contains beeswax, carnauba and orange oils, and will protect against moisture, spills and cracking on finished and unfinished wood. Great over raw wood, reclaimed, antiques, milk paint, midcentury or modern furniture. Available in an 8 ounce tin, which when applied once per month, will last for about a year per item (one bed, one dining table... )

Application Instructions:
Apply liberally, working with the direction of the grain. Wait 10 minutes, then buff back excess with a clean cloth, buffing in the direction of grain.

About the product:
Lareaux's Furniture Paste Wax was developed in-house after learning what really goes into commercially available paste wax products. We developed this product after we tried everyone else's waxes, creams and polishes, aiming for something superior.

We removed the harsh solvents that slowly degrade the finish of your furniture, from the high end woodworkers paste waxes (that contain turpentine or mineral spirits), to products like "Howard's Feed n' Wax" that contains the same solvent used in Zippo lighter fluids (naphtha) to "Pledge" that dry out the wood over time... this isn't stuff you want to put on your table or have around your family, let alone touch or come into contact with daily!

After playing around for several months, we developed a great product with NO harsh solvents. Our wax increases moisture resistance, suppleness, and will condition and highlight the natural beauty of raw, reclaimed and finished furniture both new and old. Contains Organic Beeswax, Organic Carnauba Wax, Orange Oil and a third (food safe) secret ingredient.

Ships within 3–5 business days via standard ground.

This law requires specific stability tests, including checks on carpeting, assessments with loaded and open drawers, and simulations involving children weighing up to 60 pounds.
